description: Superabsorbent polymers (SAP) (also called slush powder) are polymers that can absorb and retain extremely large amounts of a liquid relative to their own mass.   SAP may absorb 500 times its weight (from 30–60 times its own volume) and can become up to 99.9% liquid, but when put into a 0.9% saline solution, the absorbency drops to maybe 50 times its weight.   The largest use of SAP is found in personal disposable hygiene products, such as baby diapers, adult protective underwear and sanitary napkins. SAP is also used for blocking water penetration in underground power or communications cable, horticultural water retention agents, control of spill and waste aqueous fluid, artificial snow for motion picture and stage production. The first commercial use was in 1978 for use in feminine napkins in Japan and disposable bed liners for nursing home patients in the USA.

If the spring is broken, damaged, or faulty the door flap will swing open and block the door from closing, and you should look to replace the part straight away to prevent further damage to the door. description: The instructions work for most Samsung dryers, some may have some small differences. Here is how to replace the DC97-14486A heating element: STEP1: Shut off the power to the dryer before working on it. STEP2: Remove the two screws securing the top panel to the back of the dryer. Slide the top panel towards the back of the dryer to remove. You will need to remove the front control panel, some model have screws securing this. Remove them and pull up to remove, you should have enough extra wire to set the control panel on top of the dryer to get it out of the way. if not, then disconnect the wires and set it off to the side. Behind where the control panel was there will be four screws that secure the front panel of the dryer to the frame. Remove these four screws. STEP3: Open the door of the dryer, there will be two screws that need to be removed at the bottom of the door frame area. With those two screws removed you should be able to tilt the front panel forward, remove the connector to the door switch, and remove the front panel. STEP4: The heating element is located on the bottom right side of the dryer. To remove the element you will need to remove the wires to the heating element, thermal fuse, and thermostat. Then remove the mounting screw in the front and the whole heating element assembly should pull out the front of the dryer. STEP5: To re-install the heating element you will need to put everything back in the reverse order. To test the heating element, you will need an Ohm meter or multi-meter. A good heating element should read approximately 9-10 ohms. A burned out element will have an infinite resistance, it won’t register anything.

description: Pour over coffee brewing effectively gives you control over each step of the coffee making process. With your stainless steel coffee dripper, you can experiment and find that perfect calibration of water and grind for your unique taste. Here are the steps to making pour over coffee (paperless): First, "rinse" the pour over coffee maker with hot water; this serves to preheat the filter before use. Second, dump this water and fill the filter with ground coffee, gently tapping the edges to even the bed. Third, begin a brief stage of pre-infusion: pour about 10% of the total water volume evenly across the coffee, start a timer, and wait 30-45 seconds. This releases gases that build up during roasting, an event seen in the "blooming" of fresh coffee. Fourth and immediately afterwards, continue pouring in a slow, circular, in-and-out motion for about 90 seconds or so. Fifth, continue pouring directly into the middle of the pour over coffee maker, keeping the water level consistent. Shoot for a total brew time of 3:00-3:30. Lastly, remove the filter from the server (cup or pot), dump the grounds, scrub the filter, and serve coffee straight from your server of choice.

title: Pymeter Humidistat Temperature Humidity Controller Reptile Mushroom Greenhouse Thermostat Dual Controlled Outlets Heater Fridge Humidifier Dehumidifier
categories: Appliances | Parts & Accessories | Humidifier Parts & Accessories | Humidity Meters
description: 1. How Pymeter control Temperature? Temperature controller is actual Heating/Cooling controller, thus MUST SET ON-Temp to turn ON Heating/Cooling, and MUST SET OFF-Temp to turn OFF Heating/Cooling. Heating starts at LOW Temp [ON-Temp(1tN)], stops at HIGH Temp [OFF-Temp(1tF)], thus for heating MUST SET 1tN LESS than 1tF; In heating mode, 1tN is the minimum temp you allow, 1tF is the maximum temp you allow. Cooling starts at HIGH Temp [ON-Temp(1tN)], stops at LOW Temp [OFF-Temp(1tF)], thus for cooling MUST SET 1tN GREATER than 1tF. In cooling mode, 1tN is the maximum temp you allow, 1tF is the minimum temp you allow. 2. How Pymeter control Humidity? Humidification starts at LOW Humidity [ON-Humidity(2hn)], stops at HIGH Humidity [OFF-Humidity(2hF)], thus for humidification MUST SET 2hn LESS than 2hF; In humidification mode, 2hn is the minimum humidity you allow, 2hF is the maximum humidity you allow. Dehumidification starts at HIGH Humidity [ON-Humidity(2hn)], stops at LOW Humidity [OFF-Humidity(2hF)], thus for dehumidification MUST SET 2hn GREATER than 2hF. In dehumidification mode, 2hn is the maximum humidity you allow, 2hF is the minimum humidity you allow.

Flush new cartridge by dispensing water for about 5 minutes. Your refrigerator manufacturer recommends dispensing at least 2 gallons of water to remove trapped air from the water line and discharging any loose charcoal sediment.Tip: On almost all refrigerators, your reminder light is simply a 6 month timer, it doesn't measure water volume or tell you if your filter is clogged. Your filter may last for more or less time depending on your local water quality and how much water you use. If your water flow is reduced, or it begins to taste like tap water, you know it is time to change your filter.

description: Why buy the Recycle A Cup® Cutter? Millions of people across the United States use pod-based coffee brewing systems to create their morning cup of jo. While these single cup coffee pod machines are undoubtedly convenient, their single-use nature generates a significant amount of waste. This means that many end up in landfills, where they will sit for hundreds of years – or worse, be blown into nearby waterways where they could affect wildlife. Coffee pods are great, but they can produce a bunch of waste! The coffee pods can only be recycled if the plastic, aluminum, paper and coffee components are separated and sorted into the correct categories for recycling or composting. The Recycle A Cup® works with the majority of coffee pod brands like Keurig and allows you to separate the pod into the components for recycling and composting. The Recycle A Cup cutter comes in a Single Pack containing two coffee pod recycling tools, a Double Pack containing four cutters, and a Triple Pack containing six cutters. It’s as easy as making your coffee, separating the pod, then recycling the coffee pod.
